advisor_identified: Historian of health and medicine at York University, also listed as Georgiana D. Feldberg and known as Gina Feldberg.

doctorate.title: "An Antitoxin of Self Respect": North American Debates Over Vaccination Against Tuberculosis, 1890-1960

evidence.says: York identifies Gina Feldberg as a Health & Society faculty member in Social Science, describes her Harvard graduate study in the history of science and medicine, and says her dissertation compared American and Canadian tuberculosis control and became Disease and Class.
The indexed faculty-calendar entry lists Georgiana D. Feldberg as an associate professor of Social Science with a Harvard PhD.
The indexed extract of Harvard’s PhD theses list, page 6, lists Georgiana Feldberg in 1989 with the exact linked dissertation title, including the 1890-1960 date range.

Kathryn McPherson’s obituary in the Canadian Historical Association Bulletin, printed page 44, identifies Gina (Georgina) Feldberg as a York historian and graduate supervisor and states that she earned her Harvard PhD in History of Science in 1987.

notes: The institution, exact dissertation title and York research biography establish the match. Year remains unresolved: the supplied AHA record says 1988, Harvard’s departmental list says 1989, and the CHA obituary says 1987. Harvard and York calendar evidence was available through search-indexed extracts; their PDFs could not be retrieved directly.
